subject: general
question: The last Nawab of Awadh was ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Wajid Ali Shah**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Wajid Ali Shah was the eleventh and last King of Awadh.
 
• **Lord Dalhousie**, Governor General of British India, had deposed him under the** pretext of misgovernance in February 1856.**
 
• Wajid Ali Shah's** first wife was Alam Ara **who was better known as** Khas Mahal.**
 
• **Begum Hazrat Mahal**, also known as the Begum of Awadh, was the** second wife of Nawab of Awadh Wajid Ali Shah.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **About Awadh**.

 
 
• The **ancient name** of Awadh was ** Kosala,**
 
• The Avadh is located in **Uttar Pradesh**.
 
• Awadh city is located on the bank of the** Gomti river**.
 
• **Saadat Khan Burhanul Mulk **is also known as the father of Awadh, **established in 1722.**
 
• **Faizabad **was made the first capital of Awadh.
 
• Wajid Ali Shah was the eleventh and last King of Awadh.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• ** Mir Jafar**-first Bengal ruler (1757–60; 1763–65) under British influence.
 
• **Ali Vardi Khan**-Alivardi Khan(1676-1756) **Nawab of Bengal, Bihar and Orissa** (1740-1756).
 
• **Nawab Sayyid Mansur Ali Khan **was the Nawab of Bengal from** 1838 until his abdication in 1880.**
